turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly measures the customer’s promotion criterion and can expose tenant-specific tail-latency regressions that the mean benchmark hides.
turn_1.expected_observation: The held-out tenant-class workload will reveal whether p99 is below 250 ms for every class; based on the mean-only evidence, I predict it will not satisfy the objective for all classes.

turn_2.lesson: Aggregate mean latency can hide tenant-specific tail regressions; promotion must require p99 below 250 ms for every tenant class and non-inferiority to the prior policy.
